neighbours.label: A verb or particle that completes a movement out of or away from a place or state ('were removed', 'fell', 'got out', 'exit the building'); quiet on the same subjects with a static or acquiring verb.
fire: Wardens reported that 60 wild boars were removed from the forest this winter.
The climber slipped and fell nearly thirty feet onto the ledge.
Within an hour all the old furniture was removed from the house.
The parachutist leapt from the plane and fell through the clouds.
Firefighters ordered everyone to exit the stadium through the north gates.
More than 400 tons of debris were removed from the beach after the storm.
The vase tipped over and fell from the shelf onto the tiles.
After the verdict, the reporters were removed from the courtroom.
quiet: Wardens reported that 60 wild boars were living in the forest this winter.
The climber rested for an hour on the wide ledge.
Within an hour all the old furniture was cleaned and polished.
The parachutist checked his gear twice before the flight.
Firefighters ordered pizza for everyone at the station on Friday.
More than 400 tons of debris were counted on the beach after the storm.
The vase stood on the shelf next to a framed photo.
After the verdict, the reporters were waiting in the courtroom.
